text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Inari One crosses the finish line in first place!!
The Champion of the Dirt has been decided right here, right now--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After her splendid victory produced undeniable results heading into the 'Tokyo Daishoten', I went to greet Inari One—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa-whoa!
Inari One is officially back in town!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Keeping this momentum, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
—"The Tokyo Daishoten too?"
Not if I have anything to say about it.

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
Come year-end, we're gonna be even stronger.
You get it, don't you, Inari?
You're the one who lit that "fire."

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: No matter how massive the inferno you've sparked, you'd better overcome it without fail! That's what it means to—

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text: That's what Oi spirit is all about, ain't it?

text_block_list.name: Master
text_block_list.text:
I'm lookin' forward to it.
To the festival that'll decide who's truly at the top.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"...By year's end, I'll build up even more strength.
With the spirit of Oi in my heart—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next battle is the year-end Tokyo Daishoten.
That is where the NAR's "top dog" will be decided...!
